newsitem.title: POLAND: Handlowy hits PLN 40 in high turnover.
newsitem.headline: Handlowy hits PLN 40 in high turnover.

text.p: Poland's Bank Handlowy SA rose 3.9 percent in heavy trade on Wednesday to 40 zlotys, a price around which the stock may begin to stabilise, traders said.
Handlowy's turnover was at 100.9 million zlotys, over 100 million zlotys for the second day running and on Wednesday comprising 60 percent of main market trade.
Handlowy started trade on Monday 8.3 percent above issue at 37.9 zlotys, below many analysts' predictions of 40 zlotys or higher.

The 9.75-million-share retail tranche of the bank's May-June offering at 35 zlotys each was three times subscribed and the 19.5-million-share institutional tranche was 17.4 times subscribed with foreign demand over $3.5 billion.
The 24-percent long-term investor tranche went to JP Morgan, Zurich Insurance and Swedbank.
Handlowy's Global Depositary Receipts (GDRs) currently trade on the London bourse.
